reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known ODS approach (Y2O3) with the specific TiVNbTa alloy system, which has not been studied with ODS in the provided passages. It also links the ODS mechanism to the edge-dislocation-controlled high-temperature strength behavior reported for other refractory HEAs, proposing a synthesis that none of the passages explicitly suggests for this alloy. This constitutes a transfer of an established strengthening method to a new alloy with a mechanistic justification.
